invalidation: base/source hash or Variant/local override changes invalidate inherited checks. Individual bounds, mount, ports, workpiece and runtime evidence never inherited blindly.
promotion: USD shape validity alone cannot promote GEOMETRY_VERIFIED; type/shape review and source evidence required. Presence of collider, animation hook or port name does not certify physical/function/port.
legacy: Preserve10 reference-layout ASSET_READY records; do not count as strict full-chain ASSET_READY.
REAL: Must additionally prove actual identity/read-only connection/tag read/value change/timestamp/event correlation/repeat observations; simulation excluded.
runtimeActions: No device connection, no business writes, no source USD edits.
